form.official-title: To consolidate construction authorities, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Consolidated Construction Act.
The Secretary concerned may acquire real property and carry out military construction projects for the installations named in the funding table, in a total amount of $4,500,000.

subsection.text: The Secretary may construct family housing units in a total amount of $2,250,000.
Amounts authorized under subsection (a) shall remain available until September 30, 2030.

section.text: The Secretary of the Army may carry out construction projects for the Army National Guard in a total amount of $980,000.
The Secretary of Veterans Affairs may carry out major medical facility projects in a total amount of $7,100,000.
The Secretary of Veterans Affairs may enter into leases for medical facilities in a total amount of $650,000 per year.
